name: Proto.io
description_en:
Proto.io is a browser-based interaction prototyping tool with reusable components, events/actions, timeline animation and design-tool imports.

It helps demonstrate a flow and gather feedback before implementation; active-project capacity, author seats and sharing/export access determine the usable plan.
description_zh:
Proto.io 是浏览器交互原型工具，提供可复用组件、事件/动作、时间线动画和设计工具导入。

它帮助在实现前展示流程并收集反馈；可用套餐取决于活跃项目容量、作者席位和分享/导出权限。

core_features.explanation_en: The site documents events/actions, variables, nested scrolling and timeline transitions for more than static screen links.
core_features.explanation_zh: 网站记录事件/动作、变量、嵌套滚动和时间线过渡，支持超出静态屏幕链接的交互。

core_features.name_zh: 可复用容器与导入设计
core_features.explanation_en: Feature documentation describes shared reusable containers and imports from Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD and Photoshop.
core_features.explanation_zh: 功能文档描述可复用容器，以及从 Figma、Sketch、Adobe XD、Photoshop 导入。

core_features.explanation_en: The site lists browser/mobile previews, comments, share snapshots and HTML/PNG/PDF export; free-plan entitlement is limited.
core_features.explanation_zh: 网站列出网页/移动预览、评论、分享快照和 HTML/PNG/PDF 导出；免费档权益有限。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Actual monthly USD 29/49/99/199 for Freelancer/Startup/Agency/Corporate, with 1/2/5/10 authors and 5/10/15/30 active projects.15-day no-card trial; limited Free one project/five screens/10 MB. Annual rates and free export markers unconfirmed. Cancellation timing differs between terms and FAQ.

Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Prototype a behavior with explicit states
sections.title_zh: 用明确状态制作行为原型
sections.en:
Proto.io’s browser editor provides drag-and-drop UI components and templates, then adds events/actions, scrollable areas and animation. Reusable containers can keep a header or menu consistent across screens; variables can support changing values. Timeline transitions control timing and easing, while media components include video, audio and Lottie. These are documented interaction tools, not proof that a prototype implements a production backend.

For a hypothetical form flow, build the initial, validation-error and success states and make it clear which transitions are simulated. Keep one shared component for repeated UI and test keyboard, touch and scrolling behavior on the intended preview device. A convincing demo can still hide an impossible task path or inaccessible control. No prototype, event, variable or device interaction was executed in this research.
sections.zh:
Proto.io 浏览器编辑器提供拖放 UI 组件和模板，再加入事件/动作、滚动区域和动画。可复用容器能让页眉或菜单在不同屏幕保持一致，变量可支持变化数值。时间线过渡控制时序和缓动，媒体组件包括视频、音频和 Lottie。这些是文档交互工具，不证明原型实现了生产后端。

以表单流程为假设，可建立初始、校验错误和成功状态，并说明哪些过渡是模拟的。重复 UI 使用共享组件，并在目标预览设备上检查键盘、触摸和滚动。看起来逼真的演示仍可能隐藏无法完成的路径或不可访问控件。本研究未执行原型、事件、变量或设备交互。

sections.title_en: Import artwork, then verify the behavior
sections.title_zh: 导入画面后仍需核对行为
sections.en:
The feature page documents plugins for Sketch, Figma, Adobe XD and Photoshop, uploaded or linked assets and font sources including Google/Adobe/custom web fonts. It also describes HTML/webview components and third-party video embedding. Importing a design is a starting point for interaction work; compatibility with every current plugin version, font and layout was not tested.

After import, inspect text wrapping, clipped images and reusable elements, then add or validate the interactions needed for the study. Review rights for uploaded fonts, stock assets and externally embedded content before sharing. Off-platform media and webviews can have connectivity, cookie or data behavior separate from the core prototype. No offline or zero-transmission promise is inferred from a no-code editor.
sections.zh:
功能页记录 Sketch、Figma、Adobe XD、Photoshop 插件，上传或链接素材，以及 Google/Adobe/自有网页字体来源，也描述 HTML/Webview 组件和第三方视频嵌入。导入设计只是交互工作的起点，未验证每个现行插件版本、字体和布局兼容性。

导入后应检查文字换行、图片裁切和复用元素，再添加或验证研究需要的交互。分享前检查上传字体、图库和外部嵌入内容的权利。平台外媒体与 Webview 可能有独立的网络、Cookie 或数据行为，不能由无代码编辑器推断离线或零传输保证。

sections.title_en: Choose the preview and the evidence handoff
sections.title_zh: 选择预览及证据交接方式
sections.en:
The homepage describes web/mobile-browser previews and native iOS/Android preview apps, including offline viewing. Sharing can use links or a snapshot of the prototype at a particular moment; paid plans list comments, unlimited reviewers and HTML/PNG/PDF exports. An HTML export is documented for viewing a prototype offline, not a verified production app, deployable backend or source-code handoff equivalent.

A research round should preserve the snapshot/version, task instructions and any separate testing-tool results together. Preview the exact shared artifact, especially if it depends on remote fonts or media. Reviewers can comment without becoming author seats, but the needed sharing/export permissions must exist in the plan. No link permissions, imported layout, offline package or user-testing integration was exercised.
sections.zh:
首页描述网页/移动浏览器预览和原生 iOS/Android 预览 App，包括离线查看。分享可通过链接或原型特定时刻的快照；付费套餐列出评论、无限评审者和 HTML/PNG/PDF 导出。HTML 导出被描述为离线查看原型，不是已验证生产应用、可部署后端或等价源码交接。

一轮研究应一起保留快照/版本、任务说明及独立测试工具结果。应预览实际分享产物，尤其检查远程字体或媒体依赖。评审者评论不等于作者席位，但套餐必须提供所需分享/导出权限。本研究未测试链接权限、导入布局、离线包或用户测试集成。

sections.title_en: Paid author seats and active projects are bounded
sections.title_zh: 付费作者席位和活跃项目有上限
sections.en:
The actual monthly browser view lists Freelancer USD 29 for one user/five active projects, Startup USD 49 for two users/ten projects, Agency USD 99 for five users/fifteen projects and Corporate USD 199 for ten users/thirty projects. The service terms specify USD unless otherwise stated. Paid cards list unlimited reviewers; Enterprise can customize additional users, unlimited projects and SSO. Static HTML concatenates monthly and annual numbers, so only the unambiguous monthly browser prices are quoted here; annual checkout rates remain unconfirmed.

A 15-day full-feature trial requires no credit card. After expiry, the page offers a limited free plan with one user, one active project, five screens and 10 MB storage. The free-plan popup contains export/sharing feature labels without reliable inclusion markers in the reader. Do not assume it includes every paid export, plugin or reviewer feature simply because the pricing hero says all features on all plans. The paid-plan FAQ is more specific about paid entitlements.
sections.zh:
实际月付浏览器状态列出 Freelancer：USD29、一位用户/五个活跃项目；Startup：USD49、两位/十个；Agency：USD99、五位/十五个；Corporate：USD199、十位/三十个。服务条款规定除另行说明外用 USD。付费卡片列出无限评审者，Enterprise 可定制更多用户、无限项目和 SSO。静态 HTML 将月付和年付数字拼接，因此本稿只引用清晰的实际月付报价，年付结账价仍未确认。

15 天完整功能试用不需要信用卡。到期后页面提供有限免费档：一用户、一活跃项目、五个屏幕、10 MB 空间。免费弹窗包含导出/分享功能名称，但读取结果没有可靠的包含标记，不能因为价格页标题说“所有套餐所有功能”就推定免费档拥有全部付费导出、插件或评审者功能。付费 FAQ 对付费权益的描述更明确。

sections.title_en: Export before ending the paid workspace
sections.title_zh: 付费工作区结束前先导出
sections.en:
The terms say customers retain their Client Materials and resulting prototypes while Proto.io retains service intellectual property, with a limited internal-use access license. Payments are recurring and generally nonrefundable. The price FAQ says a canceled account remains active to the paid cycle’s end and is deleted at the next cycle, while the terms say cancellation is effective immediately. That timing difference should be resolved with the actual account/order before canceling.

The FAQ also offers paid parking: projects can be previewed on the web, but the editor and share links are unavailable. Parking is therefore not equivalent to an active client review workspace. Preserve necessary exports and the intended review access before changing plans. No cancellation, parking, data recovery, security certification or long-term retention behavior was tested.
sections.zh:
条款说客户保留 Client Materials 和生成原型，Proto.io 保留服务知识产权，并提供有限内部用途访问许可。付款会循环发生且通常不可退款。价格 FAQ 说取消账户在已付周期结束前有效，下个周期开始时删除；条款则说取消立即生效。取消前应按实际账户/订单解决这一时间差异。

FAQ 还提供付费停车保存：可在网页预览项目，但不能使用编辑器和分享链接。因此停车不等于有效客户评审工作区。更换套餐前，应保存所需导出并确认评审访问。取消、停车、数据恢复、安全认证或长期保留行为均未测试。
